/* selectUserMenu - Lee JiSeob */
WITH T1 AS ( SELECT C.MENU_ID AS MENU_NO, C.MENU_NM, (SELECT G.URL_ADDR FROM PSA100 G WHERE G.PROGRM_USE_SE_CD IN ('1', '2') AND G.PROGRM_ID = C.PROGRM_ID) AS URL_ADDR, (SELECT G.PROGRM_NM FROM PSA100 G WHERE G.PROGRM_USE_SE_CD IN ('1', '2') AND G.PROGRM_ID = C.PROGRM_ID) AS PROGRM_NM, (SELECT G.ATFINO FROM PSA100 G /* 프로그램 */ WHERE G.PROGRM_ID = C.PROGRM_ID) AS HELP_ATFINO, (SELECT G.ATCMFL_NM FROM PSA100 G WHERE G.PROGRM_ID = C.PROGRM_ID) AS HELP_FILE_NM, C.UP_MENU_NO, C.MENU_LEVELA_NO, C.RM_CN AS MENU_RM_CN, (SELECT G.RM_CN FROM PSA100 G WHERE G.PROGRM_ID = C.PROGRM_ID) AS PROGRAM_RM_CN, C.PROGRM_ID, C.PARA_CN, C.HGHRK_MENU_NO AS TOP_MENU_ID, CASE WHEN C.MENU_LEVELA_NO < 2 THEN 0 ELSE C.ME2D_NO END AS TWO_DEPTH_MENU_ID, C.SRTNG_SQNCE, C.UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD,
(SELECT NVL(MAX(D.INQ_BUTTON_USE_YN), 'N') FROM SAB250 D /* 사용자별 메뉴권한 */ WHERE D.USER_ID = #{USER_ID} AND D.MENU_NO = C.MENU_ID) AS INQ_BUTTON_USE_YN, (SELECT NVL(MAX(D.DTL_INQ_BUTTON_USE_YN), 'N') FROM SAB250 D /* 사용자별 메뉴권한 */ WHERE D.USER_ID = #{USER_ID} AND D.MENU_NO = C.MENU_ID) AS DTL_INQ_BUTTON_USE_YN, (SELECT NVL(MAX(D.INITL_BUTTON_USE_YN), 'N') FROM SAB250 D /* 사용자별 메뉴권한 */ WHERE D.USER_ID = #{USER_ID} AND D.MENU_NO = C.MENU_ID) AS INITL_BUTTON_USE_YN, (SELECT NVL(MAX(D.REG_BUTTON_USE_YN), 'N') FROM SAB250 D /* 사용자별 메뉴권한 */ WHERE D.USER_ID = #{USER_ID} AND D.MENU_NO = C.MENU_ID) AS REG_BUTTON_USE_YN, (SELECT NVL(MAX(D.MDFCN_BUTTON_USE_YN), 'N') FROM SAB250 D /* 사용자별 메뉴권한 */ WHERE D.USER_ID = #{USER_ID} AND D.MENU_NO = C.MENU_ID) AS MDFCN_BUTTON_USE_YN, (SELECT NVL(MAX(D.DEL_BUTTON_USE_YN), 'N') FROM SAB250 D /* 사용자별 메뉴권한 */ WHERE D.USER_ID = #{USER_ID} AND D.MENU_NO = C.MENU_ID) AS DEL_BUTTON_USE_YN, (SELECT NVL(MAX(D.MNG_BUTTON_USE_YN), 'N') FROM SAB250 D /* 사용자별 메뉴권한 */ WHERE D.USER_ID = #{USER_ID} AND D.MENU_NO = C.MENU_ID) AS MNG_BUTTON_USE_YN, (SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(D.USER_ID) > 0 THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END FROM SAB250 D /* 사용자별 메뉴권한 */ WHERE D.USER_ID = #{USER_ID} AND D.MENU_NO = C.MENU_ID) AS RIGHT_EXISTS
FROM PSA110 C WHERE C.MENU_ID IN (
SELECT '0' AS MENU_NO FROM DUAL
UNION ALL
SELECT TO_CHAR(D.MENU_NO) FROM SAB250 D /* 사용자별 메뉴권한 */ WHERE D.USER_ID = #{USER_ID} ) ) SELECT LEVEL, /* LPAD(' ', 4 * (LEVEL-1)) || E.MENU_NM AS ENAME, */ E.MENU_NO, E.MENU_NM, E.URL_ADDR, E.PROGRM_NM, E.UP_MENU_NO AS UP_MENU_ID, (SELECT F.MENU_NM FROM PSA110 F WHERE F.MENU_NO = E.UP_MENU_NO) AS UP_MENU_NM, E.HELP_ATFINO, E.HELP_FILE_NM, E.MENU_LEVELA_NO, E.MENU_RM_CN, E.PROGRAM_RM_CN, E.PROGRM_ID, (SELECT G.OUTSD_PROGRM_YN FROM PSA100 G /* 프로그램 */ WHERE G.PROGRM_ID = E.PROGRM_ID) AS OUTSD_PROGRM_YN, E.PARA_CN, E.TOP_MENU_ID, (SELECT F.MENU_NM FROM PSA110 F WHERE F.MENU_NO = E.TOP_MENU_ID) AS TOP_MENU_NM, E.TWO_DEPTH_MENU_ID, (SELECT F.MENU_NM FROM PSA110 F WHERE F.MENU_NO = E.TWO_DEPTH_MENU_ID) AS TWO_DEPTH_MENU_NM,
E.UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD,
E.INQ_BUTTON_USE_YN, E.DTL_INQ_BUTTON_USE_YN, E.INITL_BUTTON_USE_YN, E.REG_BUTTON_USE_YN, E.MDFCN_BUTTON_USE_YN, E.DEL_BUTTON_USE_YN, E.MNG_BUTTON_USE_YN, E.RIGHT_EXISTS
FROM T1 E START WITH E.UP_MENU_NO = '0' CONNECT BY PRIOR E.MENU_NO = E.UP_MENU_NO
AND E.MENU_NO != 161
ORDER SIBLINGS BY E.SRTNG_SQNCE, E.MENU_NO

/* selectMenuRights - Lee JiSeob */
SELECT LEVEL, LPAD(' ', 4 * (LEVEL-1)) || C.MENU_NM AS ENAME, C.MENU_NO, C.MENU_NM, (SELECT G.URL_ADDR FROM PSA100 G WHERE G.PROGRM_ID = C.PROGRM_ID) AS URL_ADDR, (SELECT G.PROGRM_NM FROM PSA100 G WHERE G.PROGRM_ID = C.PROGRM_ID) AS PROGRM_NM, C.UP_MENU_NO AS UP_MENU_ID, (SELECT F.MENU_NM FROM PSA110 F WHERE F.MENU_NO = C.UP_MENU_NO) AS UP_MENU_NM, C.MENU_LEVELA_NO, C.RM_CN AS MENU_RM_CN, (SELECT G.RM_CN FROM PSA100 G WHERE G.PROGRM_ID = C.PROGRM_ID) AS PROGRAM_RM_CN, C.TOP_MENU_ID, (SELECT F.MENU_NM FROM PSA110 F WHERE F.MENU_NO = C.TOP_MENU_ID) AS TOP_MENU_NM, (SELECT NVL(MAX(D.INQ_BUTTON_USE_YN), 'N') FROM SAB300 D WHERE D.AUTHRT_ID = #{rightId} AND D.MENU_NO = C.MENU_ID) AS RIGHT_VIEW, (SELECT NVL(MAX(D.DTL_INQ_BUTTON_USE_YN), 'N') FROM SAB300 D WHERE D.AUTHRT_ID = #{rightId} AND D.MENU_NO = C.MENU_ID) AS RIGHT_DETAIL, (SELECT NVL(MAX(D.INITL_BUTTON_USE_YN), 'N') FROM SAB300 D WHERE D.AUTHRT_ID = #{rightId} AND D.MENU_NO = C.MENU_ID) AS RIGHT_INIT, (SELECT NVL(MAX(D.REG_BUTTON_USE_YN), 'N') FROM SAB300 D WHERE D.AUTHRT_ID = #{rightId} AND D.MENU_NO = C.MENU_ID) AS RIGHT_CREATE, (SELECT NVL(MAX(D.MDFCN_BUTTON_USE_YN), 'N') FROM SAB300 D WHERE D.AUTHRT_ID = #{rightId} AND D.MENU_NO = C.MENU_ID) AS RIGHT_UPDATE, (SELECT NVL(MAX(D.DEL_BUTTON_USE_YN), 'N') FROM SAB300 D WHERE D.AUTHRT_ID = #{rightId} AND D.MENU_NO = C.MENU_ID) AS RIGHT_DELETE, (SELECT NVL(MAX(D.MNG_BUTTON_USE_YN), 'N') FROM SAB300 D WHERE D.AUTHRT_ID = #{rightId} AND D.MENU_NO = C.MENU_ID) AS RIGHT_MANAGE, (SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(D.AUTHRT_ID) > 0 THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END FROM SAB300 D WHERE D.AUTHRT_ID = #{rightId} AND D.MENU_NO = C.MENU_ID) AS RIGHT_EXISTS FROM PSA110 C START WITH C.UP_MENU_NO = 0 CONNECT BY PRIOR C.MENU_ID = C.UP_MENU_NO
